user.title: Simple Aisle
user.description: Keeps chosen Simple Aisle stores in sync with Home Assistant's own Shopping List and Local To-do lists. After adding it, open **Simple Aisle** in the sidebar and choose **Pair device**, then scan the code with Simple Aisle on your iPhone or iPad (Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Simple Aisle is already set up.

data.purchased_action: When something is bought in Simple Aisle
data.notify_when_waiting: Notify when changes have waited an hour

data_description.notify_service: Home Assistant can't wake Simple Aisle. Request sync sends this notification instead, and tapping it opens Simple Aisle. Separate several with commas.
data_description.notify_when_waiting: At most one notification an hour.

options.complete: Check it off on the Home Assistant list
options.remove: Remove it from the Home Assistant list

move_item.name: Move item to another store
move_item.description: Moves an item from one linked list to another. Simple Aisle moves it too, keeping its quantity and note, and records no purchase.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The linked list the item is on.

target_entity_id.name: Destination list
target_entity_id.description: A list linked to another Simple Aisle store.

target_store_id.name: Destination store ID
target_store_id.description: Or the Simple Aisle store's ID.

request_sync.name: Request sync
request_sync.description: Sends the configured notification asking a phone to open Simple Aisle. iOS doesn't let Home Assistant start Simple Aisle by itself.
